guitar.evidence: Both guitarists have long-running, well-documented Schecter signature models (Synyster Gates Custom, Zacky Vengeance signature) used consistently live and in the studio.

tone.target: modern metal crunch with wah lead bite
tone.profile: modern metal crunch with wah lead bite
tone.summary: A tight signal chain utilizing a boost/OD for rhythm punch, followed by a high-gain Recti amp model, paired with a 4x12 cab. Wah effect is placed after the distortion stage to shape the leads.

rig.name: Avenged Sevenfold - Bat Country - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Cleaning up high-gain noise and hum.
Adding punch and tightening the rhythm attack for palm-muting.
Providing high-gain metal crunch without fuzz texture.
blocks.gap: The 'Distortion' model is used as a general high-gain platform, simulating the necessary tight saturation of modern metal.

alternatives.model: RAT-style (if more aggressive bite is needed)

blocks.purpose: Simulating the decisive wah lead sweeps required for solos and leads.
blocks.gap: The OD 9 is used to simulate a filter/wah effect, as no dedicated Wah module exists in the compact catalog. Settings are adjusted for sweep functionality.

blocks.purpose: Modeling the Mesa/Rectifier-style high-gain amp tone.
Providing a robust and articulate 4x12 cabinet sound suitable for metal.
blocks.gap: While the Recti amp is modeled, pairing it with the UK Vintage 4x12 provides a balanced, powerful voicing that complements modern metal tones.

blocks.purpose: Scooping the low end while boosting cutting mids for clarity and bite.
Adding subtle depth and dimension without sounding overly wet or vintage.
blocks.gap: The Room reverb is used sparingly to add space, avoiding the 'warm vintage breakup' sound while maintaining modern clarity.

alternatives.model: Plate (if a more controlled decay is preferred)

improvements.summary: Upgrade IR for better cabinet realism and articulation.

proposals.reason: Improve modern metal punch and clarity.
